note: R5-SHOTS: the blind set's seven hero frames, picked from the trailer's shots in its proportions (two first-person street frames, a street wide, a roof against the sun, two boss frames, one more). `frame` is the output frame (24 fps) counted from the start of the shot's window; the plates are made at these frames with tools/video/make_plate.sh. tools/video/shoot_hero.sh renders them at 2560x1440.

frames.note: First person, the jab's contact: the lead fist in the lower left, the Punk's head snapping back, the chain-link fence and the lamp behind him.
First person, the perfect block: the Kicker's jump kick lands on the guard, the lamp's pool and the barrel behind.
The tilt-down's end from the fixed point 6.6 m up: a fight in the lamp's pool, small, the fire escape's rail in the foreground, the vanishing point off-centre.
The Kicker launched up against the sun, the near water tower a big foreground mass at the right, the far one pushed to the left edge.
Ox at the left third against the brightest fire, pitched-up low camera, his arm out as he raises his guard.
Three-quarter over the player's shoulder after the haymaker lands: the dark foreground mass of the player and the glove, the fire behind.
First person on the roof, the chain's first hit: the Punk's head and guard against the sunset, the parapet behind.
